subject.title: feat(canvas): export widgets as PNG — copy or download from the card menu

question: Should the Control UI retain this new core widget-export surface after the strict-sandbox and snapshot-fidelity cases are repaired and demonstrated?
rationale: This is a new user-facing core UI capability under a protected maintainer label; implementation repairs are clear, but accepting the permanent product surface needs maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the feature after repairs
options.body: Retain the menu and require fixes for strict sandbox behavior, live form-state fidelity, and complete browser proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the export contract
options.body: Support export only for explicitly compatible widgets and make the unavailable state visible instead of presenting universal PNG actions.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR if the core UI should not own widget rasterization and export behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the feature after repairs
recommendation.body: Retain the menu and require fixes for strict sandbox behavior, live form-state fidelity, and complete browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history ties this person directly to the proposed canvas-export implementation and its intended product shape.
